description: Export up to 24 file-verified composite frames at active-sequence marker positions in one bridge request for marker-driven review. It reads markers and writes image files only; it does not add, update, or remove Premiere markers.

end_seconds.description: Optional positive exclusive upper bound for marker positions in seconds.

limit.description: Maximum chronological marker frames to export (default: 12; minimum: 1; maximum: 24).

marker_type.description: Optional exact Premiere marker type to include (for example Comment or Chapter).

output_dir.description: Existing directory where marker_review_001.png through marker_review_NNN.png will be written

start_seconds.description: Optional non-negative lower bound for marker positions in seconds.

name: export_sequence_marker_review_frames

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Export Sequence Marker Review Frames
